rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes 10-17 m behind it and cars parked opposite.
reasons: Slope about 4% on the flattest stretch

drivers.seclusion: West kerb fronts gardens and houses with pools, about 10-17 m back; opposite side is bush with one house set well back.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars parked along the east kerb in the Esri image; room beside the lane on the west side is a normal kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street running down to a cross street at the south end.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; signs give 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm only, no overnight restriction.

Dwellings within 10-17 m on its own side
Signs: 2P limit in weekday daytime hours
sun_shade: Patchy tree canopy; the west side gets afternoon sun, the bush opposite shades the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the unclassified buildings at 8-17 m are homes

best_section.where: west kerb below the bend, opposite the parked cars and the dark-roofed house in the bush
